definitions.gloss: lunch time; lunch hours; lunch service period
definitions.explanation: The time period during which lunch is served, typically when special lunch menus are available at restaurants.

examples.japanese: ランチタイムは{混|こ}んでいる。
ランチタイムは11{時|じ}から2{時|じ}までです。
ランチタイム{限定|げんてい}のセットメニューがお{得|とく}だ。
examples.english: The lunch-time-only set menu is a good deal.

notes:
ランチタイム is a loanword from English "lunch time" referring specifically to the lunch service period at restaurants, cafes, and cafeterias — not just the general time of day when one eats lunch.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ランチタイム{限定|げんてい} (lunch-time-only)
- ランチタイムのメニュー/セット (lunch time menu/set)
- ランチタイムは〜{時|じ}から〜{時|じ}まで (lunch hours are from ~ to ~)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, restaurant lunch service typically runs 11:00-14:00 (sometimes to 15:00). During ランチタイム, many restaurants offer セットメニュー (set menus) at lower prices than dinner. Restaurants often close between lunch and dinner ({中休|なかやす}み).

RELATED WORDS:
- ランチ: lunch (the meal itself)
- {昼食|ちゅうしょく}: lunch (formal/written)
- お{昼|ひる}: lunch (casual)
- ディナータイム: dinner service hours
